Follow a package across its CRAN releases

Source: R/pkg_history.R
pkg_history.Rd

Run pkg_summary() on several CRAN releases of one package to see how it grew over time. By default n releases are picked evenly across the package's history, always including the first and the latest; or name the versions you want.

Usage

pkg_history(
  package,
  versions = NULL,
  n = 5,
  include_ignored = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE,
  cache = c("session", "persistent", "none")
)

Arguments

package

Name of a CRAN package, such as "dplyr".

versions

Optional character vector of versions to analyse, e.g. c("0.8.0", "1.0.0"). See pkg_versions() for what is available. If given, n is ignored.

n

Number of releases to pick when versions is not given. If the package has n releases or fewer, all are used.

include_ignored

If TRUE, also analyse files matched by the package's .Rbuildignore. Version-control folders and R's built-in build exclusions are always skipped.

quiet

If TRUE, suppress progress messages.

cache

Where to keep downloaded GitHub and CRAN packages:

  • "session" (default): a temporary folder, removed when R closes.

  • "persistent": a user cache folder kept across R sessions. Only fixed versions are stored there: CRAN releases and GitHub refs that look like a commit SHA or a version tag ("owner/repo@v1.2.0"). Requests that can change over time (no ref, or a branch) always fetch the latest code and use the session cache instead.

  • "none": always download afresh.

Use pkg_cache_clear() to empty a cache.

Value

A pkginspectr_tbl like pkg_summary(), with one row per release, sorted by version number (oldest first), and an extra date column after version. Plot it with pkg_plot(type = "metric") to compare releases side by side.

Details

Each release is downloaded from CRAN. Old releases never change, so cache = "persistent" is a good choice if you will revisit them.

See also

pkg_versions() to list the releases.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# Five releases spread across desc's history
history <- pkg_history("desc")
history
pkg_plot(history, type = "metric")

# Specific releases, kept across R sessions
pkg_history("desc", versions = c("1.2.0", "1.4.0"), cache = "persistent")
}
